dedupe_keys.name: future typical meteorological year ftmy weather files for building simulation for every county in the contiguous us

description: This series provides Future Typical Meteorological Year (fTMY) weather files in EnergyPlus weather (EPW) format for 3,281 counties in the contiguous United States, so that building simulations can estimate the effect of climate change on the built environment. It was published on Zenodo in February and March 2024 by Shovan Chowdhury, Fengqi Li, Avery Stubbings, Joshua New, Deeksha Rastogi and Shih-Chieh Kao, mostly of Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The typical-year method selects representative months from many years; here it is applied to six CMIP6 global climate models (ACCESS-CM2, BCC-CSM2-MR, CNRM-ESM2-1, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0 and NorESM2-MM) statistically downscaled for 1980-2014 and 2015-2100, with hourly values derived from daily output by the MTCLIM model. Coverage: every county in the contiguous US, split into records by scenario (SSP3-RCP7.0 and SSP5-RCP8.5), region and a cross-model version. Access: per-state ZIP files on Zenodo, from tens of megabytes to over 2 GB. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the cross-model record's text mentions both SSP5-8.5 and SSP3-7.0; check each record's scenario. Simulation uses: future building energy, overheating and HVAC sizing studies. Related records: the Brazil future weather files and CAHDC design conditions.
